falsification.statement: On the narrow-tolerance, high-SNR slice the candidate must not trade fast thin-edge accuracy for static averaging: mean position error on 'fast' must exceed the mean on 'still' by more than 1.5 px.
falsification.threshold: delta(fast - still) > 1.5 px on the high/narrow slice

falsification.statement: The candidate must not degenerate into a maximum-window average: the effective history length must not sit within 5% of max_history, and the mean weighted support count must stay below the full (2r+1)^2 window mass.
falsification.threshold: history within 5% of max_history AND support_count >= 0.9 * window area

falsification.statement: The candidate must not be worse than the strongest static-history baseline (fixed average over the same history) on the fast+motion slice by more than 2 px.
The support graph must actually reorganise: either merge_count or split_count must be non-zero in the mechanism matrix, otherwise the hysteresis band is inert.
falsification.threshold: merge_count == 0 AND split_count == 0 on every condition

header.command: python -m owac.evaluation.n01 --config configs/encoders/n01/tiny.json --checkpoint outputs/n01-smoke/checkpoint.pt --suite mechanism --output outputs/n01-eval
not_measured: closed-loop robot success rate (no robot or simulator in this run)
real camera RAW data (synthetic weak-edge task only)
hard real-time guarantees: --deadline_ms is an optional soft budget, not polled

units.budget: effective update count per step minus the declared target update count
units.latency_ms: milliseconds of wall time on this machine; the sample age (algorithmic lag) is reported separately and is never mixed into this number
units.location_heatmap: logits over the HxW measurement grid; cross-entropy target is a Gaussian heatmap with sigma in pixels
units.location_huber: pixel units: mean over the diagonal of |pred_xy - target_xy|
units.measurement_prediction: normalised measurement units (x=(raw-black)/(white-black)); target is the held-out pixel block of frame t-1, input replacement is a neighbourhood mean
units.position_error: pixels, row/col convention matching target_xy (normalised in [0,1])
